analysis.reason: 4일 연속 하락하며 RSI가 35.7로 과매도 구간에 진입했으나, MACD 히스토그램은 -1.1438로 악화되며 약세 수렴을 지속하고 있다. 주봉 ADX 26.2는 뚜렷한 추세를 시사하지만, -DI(37.6)가 +DI(13.6)를 크게 상회하며 하락 압력이 강하다. 5일 연속 음봉 출현으로 매수세 유입이 약해 관망한다.
analysis.reasonEn: The price has fallen for 4 consecutive days, with RSI entering oversold at 35.7. However, the MACD histogram has worsened to -1.1438, continuing weak convergence. The weekly ADX at 26.2 suggests a clear trend, but the -DI (37.6) significantly exceeds the +DI (13.6), indicating strong downward pressure. With 5 consecutive bearish candles, buying interest is weak, thus maintaining a wait-and-see approach.

· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.7278 → -1.1438) — Weakness persists and shows signs of worsening.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower Band $61.45) — Approaching the lower band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing Resistance ($79.68) — Resistance based on 52-week high.

· Current phase diagnosis (Distribution phase) — Observing a wait-and-see approach due to RSI entering oversold and MACD continuing weak momentum.
